
# Iteradores, Geradores e Decoradores em Python

> Este resumo reúne os conteúdos das apresentações sobre **iteradores e geradores** e **decoradores** em Python.

---

# Parte 1 — Iteradores e Geradores

## 1. Visão geral

Iteradores e geradores permitem trabalhar com sequências de dados de maneira eficiente.

Eles são especialmente úteis quando:

- A sequência possui muitos elementos;
- Os dados precisam ser processados um por vez;
- Desejamos economizar memória;
- Os valores são produzidos sob demanda;
- Os dados vêm de arquivos, APIs ou outras fontes externas.

Os principais conceitos são:

- Iteráveis;
- Iteradores;
- Protocolo de iteração;
- `iter()`;
- `next()`;
- `StopIteration`;
- Geradores;
- `yield`;
- Avaliação preguiçosa (_lazy evaluation_).

---

## 2. Objetos iteráveis

Um objeto **iterável** é aquele que pode ser percorrido item por item.

Exemplos de objetos iteráveis:

- Listas;
- Tuplas;
- Strings;
- Dicionários;
- Conjuntos;
- Arquivos;
- Objetos `range()`;
- Geradores.

python

```python
numeros = [10, 20, 30]

for numero in numeros:
    print(numero)
```

O `for` consegue percorrer a lista porque ela é iterável.

```python
texto = "Python"

for caractere in texto:
    print(caractere)
```

Cada caractere da string é obtido individualmente.

## 3. Iteradores

Um **iterador** é um objeto responsável por fornecer os elementos de um iterável, um por vez.

Ele mantém internamente a posição atual da iteração.

Para ser considerado um iterador, o objeto deve implementar dois métodos especiais:

- `__iter__()`;
- `__next__()`.

### Protocolo de iteração

O protocolo de iteração define como o Python percorre um objeto.

|Método|Função|
|---|---|
|`__iter__()`|Retorna o próprio iterador|
|`__next__()`|Retorna o próximo elemento|

## 4. Criando um iterador com `iter()`

A função `iter()` transforma um objeto iterável em um iterador.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
numeros = [10, 20, 30]

iterador = iter(numeros)

print(next(iterador))  # 10
print(next(iterador))  # 20
print(next(iterador))  # 30
```

## 5. Utilizando `next()`

A função `next()` solicita o próximo elemento de um iterador.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
frutas = ["maçã", "banana", "laranja"]

iterador = iter(frutas)

print(next(iterador))  # maçã
print(next(iterador))  # banana
print(next(iterador))  # laranja
```

A posição atual é mantida entre as chamadas:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
numeros = iter([1, 2, 3])

print(next(numeros))  # 1
print(next(numeros))  # 2
print(next(numeros))  # 3
```

Depois que um valor é consumido, o iterador avança. Ele não retorna automaticamente aos valores anteriores.

## 6. `StopIteration`

A exceção `StopIteration` indica que o iterador chegou ao fim.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
numeros = iter([1, 2])

print(next(numeros))  # 1
print(next(numeros))  # 2
print(next(numeros))  # StopIteration
```

O `for` trata essa exceção automaticamente:

python

```python
numeros = iter([1, 2])

for numero in numeros:
    print(numero)
```

## 7. Criando um iterador personalizado

Podemos criar um iterador implementando `__iter__()` e `__next__()`.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
class Contador:
    def __init__(self, limite):
        self.atual = 0
        self.limite = limite

    def __iter__(self):
        return self

    def __next__(self):
        if self.atual >= self.limite:
            raise StopIteration

        valor = self.atual
        self.atual += 1

        return valor
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
contador = Contador(3)

for numero in contador:
    print(numero)
```

```text
0
1
2
```

### Como o iterador funciona

1. `__iter__()` retorna o próprio objeto;
2. `__next__()` verifica se ainda existem valores;
3. O próximo valor é retornado;
4. O estado interno é atualizado;
5. Quando o limite é atingido, `StopIteration` é gerada.

---

## 8. Iterável versus iterador

Embora os termos sejam parecidos, eles não significam exatamente a mesma coisa.

|Conceito|Descrição|
|---|---|
|Iterável|Objeto que pode ser percorrido|
|Iterador|Objeto que fornece os valores um por vez|
|`iter()`|Cria ou obtém um iterador|
|`next()`|Obtém o próximo valor do iterador|

```python
lista = [1, 2, 3]
iterador = iter(lista)

print(iter(iterador) is iterador)
```

## 9. Iteradores e arquivos

Arquivos em Python são iteráveis. Isso permite percorrer suas linhas uma por vez.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
with open("arquivo.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as arquivo:
    for linha in arquivo:
        print(linha.strip())
```

Esse comportamento é eficiente porque o arquivo não precisa ser carregado completamente na memória.

## 10. Por que utilizar iteradores?

Iteradores são úteis para:

- Processar dados gradualmente;
- Evitar o carregamento de grandes volumes na memória;
- Trabalhar com arquivos grandes;
- Processar fluxos de dados;
- Criar sequências personalizadas;
- Interromper o processamento quando necessário.

### Exemplo

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
with open("log.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as arquivo:
    for linha in arquivo:
        if "ERRO" in linha:
            print(linha.strip())
```

Esse código pesquisa erros sem armazenar todo o arquivo na memória.

# Geradores

## 11. O que são geradores?

Geradores são tipos especiais de iteradores.

Eles são criados utilizando funções comuns, mas em vez de `return`, utilizam `yield`.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def contar():
    yield 1
    yield 2
    yield 3
```

A função não produz todos os valores imediatamente:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
gerador = contar()

print(next(gerador))  # 1
print(next(gerador))  # 2
print(next(gerador))  # 3
```

## 12. `yield` versus `return`

### Utilizando `return`

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def criar_lista():
    return [1, 2, 3]
```

A lista inteira é criada e retornada de uma vez:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
valores = criar_lista()

print(valores)
# [1, 2, 3]
```

### Utilizando `yield`

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def criar_gerador():
    yield 1
    yield 2
    yield 3
```

Os valores são produzidos um por vez:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
valores = criar_gerador()

print(next(valores))  # 1
print(next(valores))  # 2
print(next(valores))  # 3
```

|`return`|`yield`|
|---|---|
|Encerra a função|Pausa a função|
|Retorna um valor|Produz um valor por vez|
|Pode criar todos os dados de uma vez|Produz dados sob demanda|
|Não mantém o estado da execução|Mantém o estado entre chamadas|

![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.3078%200.92981C9.94255%200.92981%209.6556%201.21677%209.6556%201.58198C9.6556%201.9472%209.94255%202.23416%2010.3078%202.23416C12.473%202.23416%2014.0904%203.98198%2014.0904%206.27764V10.582C14.0904%2012.7994%2012.2643%2014.6255%2010.0469%2014.6255H5.76864C3.55125%2014.6255%201.72516%2012.7994%201.72516%2010.582V6.27764C1.72516%203.98198%203.34255%202.23416%205.50777%202.23416C5.87299%202.23416%206.15995%201.9472%206.15995%201.58198C6.15995%201.21677%205.87299%200.92981%205.50777%200.92981C2.66429%200.92981%200.420815%203.27764%200.420815%206.27764V10.582C0.420815%2013.5298%202.82081%2015.9298%205.76864%2015.9298H10.073C13.0208%2015.9298%2015.4208%2013.5298%2015.4208%2010.582V6.27764C15.3947%203.27764%2013.1773%200.92981%2010.3078%200.92981Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23717C92%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M7.90784%200.92981C7.54262%200.92981%207.25567%201.21677%207.25567%201.58198V10.2689L5.16871%208.18198C4.90784%207.92111%204.49045%207.92111%204.25567%208.18198C3.9948%208.44285%203.9948%208.86024%204.25567%209.09503L7.43827%2012.2776C7.56871%2012.4081%207.72523%2012.4602%207.90784%2012.4602C8.09045%2012.4602%208.24697%2012.4081%208.3774%2012.2776L11.56%209.09503C11.8209%208.83416%2011.8209%208.41677%2011.56%208.18198C11.2991%207.92111%2010.8818%207.92111%2010.647%208.18198L8.56001%2010.2689V1.58198C8.56001%201.21677%208.27306%200.92981%207.90784%200.92981Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23717C92%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)Exportar

## 13. Estado interno do gerador

Quando o gerador encontra `yield`, sua execução é pausada.

Na próxima chamada, a execução continua exatamente a partir do ponto em que foi interrompida.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def exemplo():
    print("Antes do primeiro yield")
    yield 1

    print("Antes do segundo yield")
    yield 2

    print("Fim da função")
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
gerador = exemplo()

print(next(gerador))
# Antes do primeiro yield
# 1

print(next(gerador))
# Antes do segundo yield
# 2

try:
    print(next(gerador))
except StopIteration:
    print("Gerador finalizado")
# Fim da função
# Gerador finalizado
```

## 14. Consumindo um gerador com `for`

Na maioria das situações, não é necessário chamar `next()` manualmente.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def contar():
    yield 1
    yield 2
    yield 3

for numero in contar():
    print(numero)
```

Saída:

text

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```text
1
2
3
```

O `for` solicita automaticamente os próximos valores até o gerador terminar.

## 15. Gerador com `range`

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def contar_ate(limite):
    numero = 1

    while numero <= limite:
        yield numero
        numero += 1
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
numeros = [numero for numero in range(1_000_000)]
```

Um gerador produz os valores conforme necessário:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
numeros = (numero for numero in range(1_000_000))
```

A expressão entre parênteses cria uma **expressão geradora**.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
print(next(numeros))  # 0
print(next(numeros))  # 1
print(next(numeros))  # 2
```

### Comparação

|Lista|Gerador|
|---|---|
|Armazena todos os valores|Produz os valores sob demanda|
|Pode consumir muita memória|Normalmente utiliza pouca memória|
|Pode ser percorrida várias vezes|Geralmente é consumido uma vez|
|Criação imediata|Criação e processamento tardios|

## 17. Expressões geradoras

Uma expressão geradora possui sintaxe semelhante a uma compreensão de lista, mas utiliza parênteses.

### Compreensão de lista

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
quadrados = [numero ** 2 for numero in range(5)]

print(quadrados)
# [0, 1, 4, 9, 16]
```

### Expressão geradora

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
quadrados = (numero ** 2 for numero in range(5))

print(next(quadrados))  # 0
print(next(quadrados))  # 1
print(next(quadrados))  # 4
```

A compreensão de lista cria todos os valores imediatamente, enquanto a expressão geradora produz um valor por vez.

```python
pares = (
```

## 19. Geradores para processamento de arquivos

Geradores podem ser utilizados para filtrar arquivos grandes.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def linhas_com_erro(nome_arquivo):
    with open(nome_arquivo, "r", encoding="utf-8") as arquivo:
        for linha in arquivo:
            if "ERRO" in linha:
                yield linha.strip()
```

python

```python
for linha in linhas_com_erro("sistema.log"):
    print(linha)
```

Apenas as linhas que contêm `"ERRO"` são produzidas.

## 20. Geradores para APIs

Geradores são úteis para consumir dados de APIs por páginas.

Em vez de carregar todos os produtos de uma vez, podemos:

1. Solicitar uma página;
2. Retornar um produto;
3. Continuar retornando produtos da página;
4. Verificar se existem novas páginas;
5. Solicitar a próxima página;
6. Repetir até o fim dos dados.

### Exemplo conceitual

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def obter_produtos():
    pagina = 1

    while True:
        resposta = buscar_pagina(pagina)

        for produto in resposta["produtos"]:
            yield produto

        if not resposta["proxima_pagina"]:
            break

        pagina += 1
```

Uso:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
for produto in obter_produtos():
    print(produto)
```

> A função `buscar_pagina()` é apenas ilustrativa. Em uma aplicação real, ela seria responsável por fazer a requisição à API.

### Vantagens

- Evita carregar todos os produtos na memória;
- Permite começar o processamento antes de obter todos os dados;
- Facilita o uso de paginação;
- Pode interromper o consumo quando necessário.

---

## 21. Limitações dos geradores

Geradores possuem algumas características importantes:

- São normalmente consumidos uma única vez;
- Depois que um valor é consumido, ele não fica disponível automaticamente;
- Não permitem acesso direto por índice;
- Não podem ser reiniciados sem criar um novo gerador.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
gerador = (numero for numero in range(3))

print(list(gerador))
# [0, 1, 2]

print(list(gerador))
# []
```

Depois de consumido, o gerador fica esgotado.

Para percorrê-lo novamente:

## 22. Iteradores e geradores: resumo comparativo

|Característica|Iterador personalizado|Gerador|
|---|---|---|
|Implementação|`__iter__()` e `__next__()`|Função com `yield`|
|Complexidade|Mais código|Mais simples|
|Controle do estado|Manual|Automático|
|Uso de memória|Pode ser eficiente|Geralmente muito eficiente|
|Finalização|`StopIteration`|Automática|
|Melhor uso|Estruturas com regras específicas|Sequências produzidas sob demanda|

# Parte 2 — Decoradores

## 23. Visão geral

Decoradores são recursos que permitem **adicionar ou modificar comportamentos de funções ou classes sem alterar diretamente seu código original**.

Eles são construídos com base em três características:

- Funções são objetos de primeira classe;
- Funções podem ser definidas dentro de outras funções;
- Funções podem ser retornadas por outras funções.

Decoradores são usados frequentemente para:

- Log;
- Autenticação;
- Validação;
- Medição de tempo;
- Controle de acesso;
- Cache;
- Controle de permissões;
- Registro de chamadas;
- Tratamento de comportamentos comuns.

---

## 24. Funções como objetos de primeira classe

Em Python, funções são objetos de primeira classe.

Isso significa que uma função pode ser:

- Atribuída a uma variável;
- Passada como argumento;
- Armazenada em uma estrutura de dados;
- Retornada por outra função.

### Atribuindo uma função a uma variável

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def saudacao():
    return "Olá!"

mensagem = saudacao

print(mensagem())
# Olá!
```

A variável `mensagem` agora referencia a mesma função que `saudacao`.

> Ao atribuir uma função, não utilize parênteses. `saudacao` referencia a função; `saudacao()` executa a função.

---

## 25. Passando funções como argumentos

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def executar(funcao):
    return funcao()

def saudacao():
    return "Olá, mundo!"

resultado = executar(saudacao)

print(resultado)
# Olá, mundo!
```

A função `executar()` recebe outra função como argumento e a chama internamente.

### Exemplo com parâmetros

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def executar_operacao(funcao, valor):
    return funcao(valor)

def dobro(numero):
    return numero * 2

resultado = executar_operacao(dobro, 5)

print(resultado)
# 10
```

---

## 26. Funções internas

Python permite definir uma função dentro de outra função.

A função interna existe apenas no escopo da função externa, a menos que seja retornada.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def funcao_externa():
    def funcao_interna():
        print("Executando a função interna.")

    funcao_interna()

funcao_externa()
```

Saída:

text

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```text
Executando a função interna.
```

A função interna também pode acessar variáveis da função externa:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def criar_saudacao(saudacao):
    def saudar(nome):
        return f"{saudacao}, {nome}!"

    return saudar
```

## 27. Retornando funções

Uma função pode retornar outra função.

Uso:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
bom_dia = criar_saudacao("Bom dia")
boa_noite = criar_saudacao("Boa noite")

print(bom_dia("Alex"))
# Bom dia, Alex!

print(boa_noite("Alex"))
# Boa noite, Alex!
```

A função `saudar()` mantém acesso ao valor recebido por `criar_saudacao()`. Esse comportamento é chamado de **closure**.

---

## 28. O que é um decorador?

Um decorador é uma função que:

1. Recebe outra função;
2. Cria ou utiliza uma função envolvedora;
3. Adiciona um comportamento;
4. Retorna a função modificada.

Estrutura geral:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def meu_decorador(funcao):
    def envelope():
        # Código executado antes
        funcao()
        # Código executado depois

    return envelope
```

## 29. Criando um decorador simples

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def meu_decorador(funcao):
    def envelope():
        print("Antes da execução.")
        funcao()
        print("Depois da execução.")

    return envelope
```

python

```python
exibir_mensagem()
```

## 30. Açúcar sintático com `@`

Python oferece uma forma mais simples de aplicar decoradores: a sintaxe `@`.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def meu_decorador(funcao):
    def envelope():
        print("Antes da execução.")
        funcao()
        print("Depois da execução.")

    return envelope
```

Aplicação com `@`:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@meu_decorador
def exibir_mensagem():
    print("Olá, mundo!")
```

## 31. Decoradores com argumentos

Se a função decorada receber argumentos, a função envolvedora também precisa aceitá-los.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def meu_decorador(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        print("Antes da execução.")
        resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)
        print("Depois da execução.")

        return resultado

    return envelope
```

O uso de `*args` e `**kwargs` permite que o decorador funcione com diferentes assinaturas.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@meu_decorador
def saudar(nome):
    return f"Olá, {nome}!"

print(saudar("Alex"))
```

python

```python
def meu_decorador(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        print(f"Argumentos posicionais: {args}")
        print(f"Argumentos nomeados: {kwargs}")

        return funcao(*args, **kwargs)

    return envelope
```

## 33. Retornando valores de funções decoradas

A função envolvedora precisa retornar o resultado da função original se quisermos preservar seu retorno.

### Decorador sem `return`

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def decorador_incorreto(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        funcao(*args, **kwargs)

    return envelope
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@decorador_incorreto
def somar(a, b):
    return a + b

resultado = somar(2, 3)

print(resultado)
# None
```

O resultado foi perdido porque `envelope()` não retornou o valor produzido por `somar()`.

### Decorador correto

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def decorador_correto(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)
        return resultado

    return envelope
```

python

## 34. Decorador para registrar chamadas

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def registrar_chamada(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        print(f"Chamando a função: {funcao.__name__}")

        resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)

        print(f"Resultado: {resultado}")

        return resultado

    return envelope
```

## 35. Decorador para medir tempo

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
from time import perf_counter


def medir_tempo(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        inicio = perf_counter()

        resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)

        fim = perf_counter()
        tempo = fim - inicio

        print(f"Tempo de execução: {tempo:.6f} segundos")

        return resultado

    return envelope
```

Uso:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@medir_tempo
def processar():
    total = 0

    for numero in range(1_000_000):
        total += numero

    return total

print(processar())
```

Esse decorador executa ações antes e depois da função para medir seu tempo de execução.

```python
def requer_autenticacao(funcao):
    def envelope(usuario, *args, **kwargs):
        if not usuario.get("autenticado"):
            print("Acesso negado.")
            return None

        return funcao(usuario, *args, **kwargs)

    return envelope
```

## 37. Preservando informações com `functools.wraps`

Quando aplicamos um decorador, a função original é substituída pela função envolvedora.

Sem cuidados adicionais, informações como o nome e a documentação da função podem ser perdidas.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def decorador(funcao):
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        return funcao(*args, **kwargs)

    return envelope
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@decorador
def somar(a, b):
    """Soma dois valores."""

print(somar.__name__)

```

Para preservar as informações originais, use `functools.wraps`:

python

```python
from functools import wraps


def decorador(funcao):
    @wraps(funcao)
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        return funcao(*args, **kwargs)

    return envelope
```

```python
print(somar.__name__)
# somar

print(somar.__doc__)
# Soma dois valores.
```

> `@wraps` é uma boa prática ao criar decoradores.

---

## 38. Introspecção

**Introspecção** é a capacidade de um objeto obter informações sobre si mesmo durante a execução do programa.

É possível verificar informações como:

- Nome;
- Tipo;
- Documentação;
- Atributos;
- Métodos;
- Anotações;
- Módulo de origem.

### Exemplos

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
def somar(a, b):
    """Retorna a soma de dois valores."""
    return a + b

print(somar.__name__)
# somar

print(somar.__doc__)
# Retorna a soma de dois valores.

print(type(somar))
# <class 'function'>
```

## 39. Decoradores com parâmetros próprios

Um decorador também pode receber argumentos.

Nesse caso, são necessárias três funções:

1. A função externa recebe os argumentos do decorador;
2. A função intermediária recebe a função que será decorada;
3. A função interna executa a lógica da decoração.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
from functools import wraps


def repetir(quantidade):
    def decorador(funcao):
        @wraps(funcao)
        def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
            resultado = None

            for _ in range(quantidade):
                resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)

            return resultado

        return envelope

    return decorador
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

## 40. Vários decoradores

É possível aplicar mais de um decorador à mesma função.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@decorador_a
@decorador_b
def funcao():
    pass
```

A ordem de aplicação equivale a:

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
funcao = decorador_a(decorador_b(funcao))
```

Ou seja:

- `decorador_b` é aplicado primeiro;
- `decorador_a` é aplicado sobre o resultado de `decorador_b`.

### Exemplo

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
from functools import wraps


def primeiro(funcao):
    @wraps(funcao)
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        print("Primeiro decorador - antes")
        resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)
        print("Primeiro decorador - depois")
        return resultado

    return envelope


def segundo(funcao):
    @wraps(funcao)
    def envelope(*args, **kwargs):
        print("Segundo decorador - antes")
        resultado = funcao(*args, **kwargs)
        print("Segundo decorador - depois")
        return resultado

    return envelope
```

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@primeiro
@segundo
def executar():
    print("Função original")

executar()
```

## 41. Decoradores de classe

Decoradores também podem ser aplicados a classes.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
@adicionar_marca
class Curso:
    pass

print(Curso.marca)
# Python
```

O decorador recebe a classe, modifica ou adiciona comportamentos e retorna a própria classe ou uma nova classe.

## 42. Decoradores built-in importantes

Python possui vários decoradores incorporados.

### `@property`

Transforma um método em uma propriedade.

python

Copiar![](data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%0A%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2216%22%20height%3D%2216%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2016%2016%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M10.8%208.63V11.57C10.8%2014.02%209.82%2015%207.37%2015H4.43C1.98%2015%201%2014.02%201%2011.57V8.63C1%206.18%201.98%205.2%204.43%205.2H7.37C9.82%205.2%2010.8%206.18%2010.8%208.63Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M15%204.42999V7.36999C15%209.81999%2014.02%2010.8%2011.57%2010.8H10.8V8.62999C10.8%206.17999%209.81995%205.19999%207.36995%205.19999H5.19995V4.42999C5.19995%201.97999%206.17995%200.999992%208.62995%200.999992H11.57C14.02%200.999992%2015%201.97999%2015%204.42999Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23717C92%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.05%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A)

```python
class Pessoa:
    def __init__(self, nome):
        self._nome = nome

    @property
    def nome(self):
        return self._nome
```

### `@classmethod`

Define um método ligado à classe.

python

```python
class Pessoa:
    especie = "Humano"

    @classmethod
    def exibir_especie(cls):

```

```python
class Matematica:
    @staticmethod
    def somar(a, b):
```

# Comparação entre conceitos

## 43. Iterador versus gerador

|Iterador|Gerador|
|---|---|
|Pode ser criado implementando `__iter__()` e `__next__()`|É criado com `yield`|
|Exige mais código|É mais simples de escrever|
|O estado precisa ser controlado manualmente|O estado é controlado automaticamente|
|Pode representar regras complexas de iteração|É ideal para produzir valores sob demanda|
|Usa `StopIteration` para indicar o fim|Também termina com `StopIteration` internamente|

## 44. Função comum versus função geradora

|Função comum|Função geradora|
|---|---|
|Utiliza normalmente `return`|Utiliza `yield`|
|Executa até o fim quando chamada|Executa sob demanda|
|Retorna um resultado|Retorna um objeto gerador|
|Pode produzir todos os dados de uma vez|Produz valores gradualmente|
|Não pausa no meio da execução|Pausa e retoma a execução|
